seoTitle: Free JSON Schema to Protobuf (proto3) Converter
metaDescription: Convert a JSON Schema into proto3 messages: nested objects, repeated fields, enums with UNSPECIFIED zero values and Timestamp. Free, in your browser.
intro: Converts a JSON Schema into proto3 messages: nested objects become messages, arrays become repeated fields, string enums gain an UNSPECIFIED zero value and date-time becomes Timestamp.
why: When a JSON API grows into gRPC, or a service must share a data contract with a protobuf system, someone has to rewrite the schema as .proto. The two models differ in ways that cause mistakes: protobuf enums need a zero value, every field needs a stable number, and there is no direct form of optional or free-form object. This tool takes a JSON Schema using properties, $ref and definitions, enums, arrays and additionalProperties, and writes proto3 messages from it. Maps come from additionalProperties, required fields are plain and others are optional. Where a oneOf or anyOf has several real branches, it falls back to google.protobuf.Value. Field numbers are assigned in order, so lock them in before shipping. It runs in your browser.
howTo: Paste a JSON Schema (draft-07 or 2020-12 subset) into the input box.
Enter an optional package name such as example.v1.
Copy the proto3 output, review the field numbers and names, and commit it only once they are final.

faq.a: String enums become a proto enum with an UNSPECIFIED value at zero, since proto3 requires a zero value, followed by the original values.

faq.q: What happens to oneOf and anyOf?
faq.a: If there is a single non-null branch, it is used. With several real branches, the field falls back to google.protobuf.Value, because protobuf has no direct equivalent.
They are assigned in the order properties appear. Once clients use the schema, do not renumber, and keep the numbers if you add fields later.
date-time becomes google.protobuf.Timestamp. Integers, numbers, booleans, strings and arrays map to their obvious proto types. Required properties are plain fields and the rest are optional.

keywords: convert json schema to proto file
